priorAttempts.disposition: Reviewer script errors, not app or article failures. The pane check expected one header chip, but the DOC-029 header fixture holds two Placeholders (counterparty_name and client_matter). The Contributor sign-in waited for / or /onboarding, but the Contributor lands elsewhere. Both checks were corrected and the full procedure was rerun with new records.

steps.action: Before you start: sign in as an Administrator
steps.actual: Signed in through /auth/login as the seeded Administrator; the banner shows the display name.

steps.action: Before you start: sign in as a Legal Team Member
steps.actual: Signed in through /auth/login as the seeded Legal Team Member; the banner shows the display name.

steps.action: Before you start: open Auto-Docs and create an Auto-Doc, then open its Form section
steps.actual: Created Auto-Doc "DOC-029 auto-docs Admin Services Agreement 1789571093287" (id 01a0aabf-d790-765f-80f8-84005015e573) with Create Auto-Doc > Name > Create; it opened on its record. The Form tab shows the template pane reading "Upload a Word file to start the form." beside the form, with an Upload version button as the guide says.

steps.action: Upload a .docx with Placeholders, one directive, and one Block with Upload version
steps.actual: Dialog caption read "Each upload adds a file version. A new Placeholder gets a form field; a removed one leaves its field in place.". After Upload the dialog reported "File version 1: 10 Placeholders, 1 Block. 8 form fields created." and closed with Close.

steps.action: Read the template pane: every Placeholder and Block is marked in the body, header, footer, footnote, and endnote; new fields follow the pane order, body first
steps.actual: Reviewer check did not complete: field order ["Counterparty name","Signing date","Fee amount","Governing law","Arbitration seat","Schedule number","Reference code","Client matter","the rule for arbitration"] does not follow pane order ["Counterparty name","Signing date","Fee amount","Governing law","Arbitration seat","Schedule number","Reference code","Client matter"]

steps.action: A directive decides the new field's type: currency directive created a Currency field, others Text
steps.actual: Selecting the fee_amount chip opened its card; Type shows "Currency". The governing_law card's Type shows "Text".

steps.action: Select a field from its chip and edit the label, type, and help from its card; the form follows each commit
steps.actual: Clicking the chip marked it selected (aria-pressed) and opened the field card with controls ["Label:1","Slug:1","Type:1","Help text:1"]. Changing Label to "Counterparty legal name" and pressing Enter renamed the card and the Fields list (["Counterparty legal name","Signing date","Fee amount","Governing law","Arbitration seat","Schedule number","Reference code","Client matter","the rule for arbitration"]). Help text saved as "Use the registered company name.".

steps.action: Write a Clause rule: open the Block under Clauses, choose When a rule matches, pick field, operator, value
steps.actual: Clauses section notes "A Block with no rule is always included.". Block tag read "arbitration · always" before the rule. Include offered ["Always","When a rule matches"]; after choosing "When a rule matches", Form field "Governing law", Operator "Equals", Value "England and Wales" the tag reads "arbitration · when Governing law equals England and Wales" and the Clauses row reads "Included when Governing law equals England and Wales".

steps.action: Negative: Publish refuses a field that cannot print its directive and names it (currency directive on a Text field)
steps.actual: With Fee amount set to Text, Publish offered ["File version 1"] / ["Form version 6","Form version 5","Form version 4","Form version 3","Form version 2","Form version 1"] and refused with "This pair cannot be published. Set \"Fee amount\" to a currency or number field for Placeholder \"{{fee_amount|currency:USD}}\".". State stayed "Draft". Type was then set back to Currency.

steps.action: Negative: an upload with an open Block is refused and the refusal quotes the text
steps.actual: Upload version refused doc029-unclosed-block.docx with "Unclosed Block: \"{{#block arbitration}}\""; the pane still shows "File version 1".

steps.action: Negative: an upload with an unclosed brace is refused and the refusal quotes the text
steps.actual: Upload version refused doc029-unclosed-brace.docx with "Unclosed Placeholder brace: \"{{counterparty_name on the date below.\""; the pane still shows "File version 1".

steps.action: Negative: an upload with a name that is not a valid slug is refused and the refusal quotes the text
steps.actual: Upload version refused doc029-bad-slug.docx with "Use a valid slug for the Placeholder or Block name: \"{{Counterparty-Name}}\""; the pane still shows "File version 1".

steps.action: Negative: an upload with a directive that is not one of the three is refused and the refusal quotes the text
steps.actual: Upload version refused doc029-bad-directive.docx with "Use upper, a supported date format, or currency with a three-letter code: \"{{counterparty_name|lower}}\"".

steps.action: Negative: a Placeholder with two directives is refused (a Placeholder takes one directive, not two)
steps.actual: Upload version refused doc029-two-directives-one-placeholder.docx with "Use upper, a supported date format, or currency with a three-letter code: \"{{counterparty_name|upper|upper}}\"".

steps.action: Supplementary: an unknown currency code is refused and the refusal quotes the text
steps.actual: Upload version refused doc029-bad-currency.docx with "Use a supported currency code: \"{{fee_amount|currency:ZZZ}}\"".

steps.action: Upload a new version that drops a Placeholder; the orphaned field is kept and marked
steps.actual: Dialog reported "File version 2: 10 Placeholders, 1 Block. 1 form field created. 1 field has no Placeholder now.". Pane shows "File version 2" with "Earlier versions (1)". Fields list ["Counterparty legal name","Signing date","Fee amount","Governing law","Arbitration seat","Schedule number","Reference code","Client matter","Notice address","the rule for arbitration"]; the Signing date row is marked "No Placeholder in file version 2" and the Form tab reads "Form1".

steps.action: Publish pins one file version and one form version together
steps.actual: Publish dialog offered file versions ["File version 2","File version 1"] and form versions ["Form version 8","Form version 7","Form version 6","Form version 5","Form version 4","Form version 3","Form version 2","Form version 1"] with caption "Later edits leave this pair unchanged until you publish again."; the newest form "Form version 8" was preselected (checked option "Form version 8"). Chose File version 2 and published; the header state reads Published and Overview reads "Live since Sep 16, 2026: file version 2, form version 8.".

steps.action: Later edits change nothing live until you publish again
steps.actual: After editing a Help text, Overview still reads "Live since Sep 16, 2026: file version 2, form version 8." and warns "Form version 9 is newer than the currently published form.".

steps.action: Remove the field or put the Placeholder back: a field whose Placeholder remains asks first; the orphaned field is removed directly
steps.actual: Remove Governing law opened "Remove Governing law?The file still holds the Placeholder {{governing_law}}. Publish will refuse until the file changes or the field is back.CancelRemove"; Cancel kept the field. Remove Signing date opened no dialog and removed the row; fields now ["Counterparty legal name","Fee amount","Governing law","Arbitration seat","Schedule number","Reference code","Client matter","Notice address","the rule for arbitration"] after reload, orphan marks left 0.
